supportDesc.support: parchment, palimpsest; paper leaf supplying a lacuna (f. 79); paper leaves with an incomplete Latin translation (ff. I-V). Watermark on the second leaf of a bird on trimount with the letter "F" above. The design is missing the letter "M", as seen in DE8580-HAAB_Q_483_b_2.
supportDesc.foliation: Foliated in pencil in Arabic numerals in the upper right corner of each recto, with occasional traces of faded, identical foliation.

collation.p: Folios or quires missing and disturbed before quire ιγ΄.
collation.signatures: Greek numerals in dark brown ink in the upper right corner of the first folio of each surviving quaternion (quires 3-10).

condition.p: Signs of humidity damage and chemical reagents on some of the parchment leaves. Missing gatherings before quire ιγ΄. Prior to conservation efforts of 1983-1984, the gatherings were completely dismantled (Formentin, 1980).

layoutDesc.layout: The number of written lines varies, following the ruling of the respective codices antiquiores.

handDesc.handNote: Copied in a single Salentine hand, identified by Arnesano (2008) as "Anonymous 3".
A second, more recent hand supplies the text of a missing original folio on f. 79, mimicking Anonymous 3.

decoDesc.decoNote: Plain initials in the same ink as the main text. They form an acrostic that is spelled out at the beginning of each liturgical day.

binding.p: The codex was rebound in the 20th century in Western-style binding, between two wooden boards with a dark brown leather spine with three raised bands.
binding.decoNote: Shelfmark in Roman numerals stamped in gold and centered at the base of the spine.
binding.condition: The original binding does not survive.

origin.p: Late 13th to early 14th century in Salento.

condition.p: Humidity and staining on the parchment due to the historical application of chemical reagents.

scriptNote.p: Cf. Parma, Biblioteca Palatina, ms. Pal. 16, Rome, Biblioteca Vallicelliana, ms. B 22, Rome, Biblioteca Vallicelliana, ms. B 34, Venice, Biblioteca Nazionale, Marciana, gr. III 2.

decoDesc.decoNote: Initials with triangular finials in red ink.
